segments.oily: A reviewer with oily skin reports the benzoyl peroxide formula dries out excess oil and, over about a year of use, decreased both her breakouts and the redness in her face.
segments.dry: A reviewer with severely dry and sensitive skin reports the product is very stripping and drying but has still helped her skin a lot.
segments.combination: A reviewer with naturally dry and oily skin reports her face becomes scaly and dry the day after use, with a burning reaction when she follows with her regular moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: one had a severe reaction with inflammation, pustules and a painful case of perioral dermatitis requiring medical treatment, while several others report no irritation at all or only brief redness and itching that resolved within about a month, alongside clearer skin.

concerns.dehydration: Dryness is very commonly reported, ranging from mild and manageable with a moisturizer to, in a couple of extreme cases, severe scaling or peeling; several reviewers recommend starting with less frequent use to reduce this.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report severe burning or redness reactions, including one requiring medical treatment for perioral dermatitis; others report the product actually reduces the redness associated with their acne over time, or causes only temporary redness and itching in the first weeks that resolves with continued use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the product destroyed her skin barrier, leading to a severe, painful case of perioral dermatitis that required an oral and topical antibiotic.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several with cystic or hormonal acne, report noticeably fewer breakouts and clearer skin after consistent use over several weeks to months; a couple of reviewers report no visible difference after a few days, which is described elsewhere as too short a trial period.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the benzoyl peroxide formula reduces excess oil that contributes to breakouts, with one specifically noting her skin stopped being oily.

extraits.texte: I really think they should stop advertising this as “safe for sensitive skin.” I wanted to try something different to deal with some mild hormonal acne I was experiencing. Used the smallest amount I could because having really sensitive skin makes me weary of introducing new products. I put on moisturizer, went to sleep, woke up and my skin was inflamed, red, and on fire. Couple hours later, hundreds of these pustules formed all over the bottom half of my face. Ultimately, this product completely destroyed my skin barrier and I suffered a severe, very painful case of perioral dermatitis. I had to go to urgent care and get prescribed an oral and topical antibiotic to help get my skin back to normal. Overall, did not have a good experience using this product. I would HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLYYYY suggest you (anyone with sensitive skin) do a small patch test before putting this all over your face.

Differin Acne Cleanser is one of the best facial treatments that I've used. I've had acne since I was about 13, and I'm 18 now. Throughout those five years, I have used alcohol-based cleansing pads, Proactive, and just regular hand soap products, none of which achieve the success of Differin. I have been using Differin Acne Cleansing for about a year now, and although it took my skin a couple of days to make the switch from different products, this treatment has decreased the number of breakouts I used to have, the redness in my face, and has just overall improved my skin. Differin Acne Cleanser is a Benzoyl Peroxide-based acne treatment, which is known to be one of the better products to use when treating acne, blemishes, and breakouts. When buying an acne treatment people tend to pay attention to the cost, smell, and effect. Differin is fairly cheap for what it can do. I buy my product from Walmart, and it costs me about $11.00, but each bottle can last up to a month. It also has no smell and is very effective for people with oily skin because it has a Benzoyl Peroxide-base, in which it dries out the excessive oil that causes breakouts and blemishes. This product has two counterparts: the Differin Moisturizer and the Differin Gel. The moisturizer is to help moisturize your skin, that way your oil glands don't over excrete to do the same task. This product costs about the same as the cleanser, and it lasts a long time, as I use it twice a day and it has lasted me about four
